blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify. One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.
blocks.zh: 当指令和奖励难以具体确定时,少发点提示是有用的。 其中一个应用程序是按例编辑,其中显示的格式变化或API迁移可能需要跨多个站点应用. 然而,这种编辑往往既取决于左上下文,也取决于右上下文,使得带有因果自递模式的生成变得尴尬. 因此,我们采用了以传播语言模式为导火索的多目标几发法,其中的实例指导在共同的画布中填充多个被蒙蔽的区域。 为了应对在几发子弹下可靠跟踪示威的已知挑战,我们进一步利用有选择地掩盖画布,以获得一种有利于以实例支持的填充量的可能性-比例奖励。 我们发现,通过几发催生基准和软件重构案例研究,演示改进了填充精度,例子指导在几个环境中产生了进一步收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Few-shot prompting lets users specify model behavior through demonstrations, without updating model parameters ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Garg et al., 2022 ) .
This is useful for test-time guidance, especially when instructions or rewards are difficult to specify ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Zamfirescu-Pereira et al., 2023 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
For instance, in editing by example, a demonstrated formatting change or API migration can illustrate a transformation to apply elsewhere ( Gupta et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) .
When a demonstrated edit must be applied at multiple sites, a natural approach is to generate the tokens in place within a shared canvas containing all demonstrations and relevant context.
We call this multi-target few-shot prompting .
blocks.zh:
少发提示让用户通过演示指定模型行为,而不更新模型参数 (Brown等人,2020年;Garg等人,2022年).
这对试验时间指导很有用,特别是在指令或奖励难以具体确定的情况下(周等人,2023年;Zamfirescu-Pereira等人,2023年;Kwon等人,2023年)。
例如,在编辑过程中,示范的格式变化或API迁移可以说明在其他地方适用的转变(Gupta等人,2023年;Wei等人,2024年)。
当一个演示编辑必须应用在多个站点时,自然的做法是在包含所有演示和相关背景的共享画布中生成已有的符号.
我们称这为多目标 少发子弹

blocks.en:
However, causal autoregressive models generate outputs as continuations, making it awkward to infill a target site using right-hand-side context.
Incorporating such context requires rearranging the prompt or using specialized infilling formats ( Bavarian et al., 2022 ; Fried et al., 2022 ) , a process that becomes more cumbersome when editing multiple sites.
Moreover, pretrained associations and sensitivity to prompt design can interfere with the model’s adherence to demonstrations ( Min et al., 2022 ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ) .
Although guidance methods have been developed to mitigate these issues, they are primarily designed for autoregressive models and do not directly apply to in-place editing ( Shi et al., 2024b ; Peng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,因果自动递减模型会产生作为续作的输出,使得使用右侧上下文填充目标网站变得尴尬.
纳入这种背景需要重新排列即时或使用专用填充格式(Bavarian等人,2022年;Fried等人,2022年),在编辑多个网站时,这一过程变得更加繁琐。
此外,事先经过训练的协会和对即时设计的敏感性会干扰模型对演示的遵守(Min等人,2022年;Wei等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2021年)。
虽然为缓解这些问题制定了指导方法,但主要设计为自旋模型,并不直接适用于现场编辑(Shi等人,2024b;Peng等人,2025).

blocks.en:
Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a natural interface for these tasks because they are not restricted to next-token prediction and can generate tokens anywhere on the shared canvas ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024a ) .
As illustrated in Figure 1 , the missing output regions are initially masked and progressively filled, while demonstrations and surrounding context remain visible.
Each generated token can therefore condition on both left and right context, avoiding the specialized prompting harnesses often needed in causal autoregressive generation ( Ou et al., 2025 ) .
Moreover, jointly infilling multiple sites allows tokens revealed at one site to inform subsequent predictions at others, helping maintain consistency ( Kim et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
传播语言模型(DLMs)为这些任务提供了自然界面,因为它们不局限于近亲预测,并且可以在共享画布上任何地方生成符号(Austin等人,2021年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年a).
如图1所示,缺失的产出区域最初被掩盖并逐步填充,而示威和周围环境仍然明显。
因此,每个生成的信号都可能附带左右两个上下文的条件,避免因果自动生成时经常需要的专门诱导装置(Ou等人,2025年)。
此外,联合填充多个地点可以使一个地点显示的标志物为其他地点的随后预测提供信息,有助于保持一致性(Kim等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Yet several challenges remain in using DLMs for multi-target few-shot prompting.
First, infilling requires allocating masked positions before generation, even though the required output lengths are generally unknown ( Xu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Second, although DLMs condition on demonstrations, they may still fail to follow them reliably.
Context-aware decoding suggests that contrasting predictions across contexts could strengthen adherence to demonstrations ( Whitammer et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2024b ) , but extending such guidance to complete DLM infills requires joint likelihoods that are often intractable or decoder-specific ( Turok et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,在利用DLM进行多目标、少发子弹方面仍然存在若干挑战。
首先,填充需要先分配遮盖位置,即使所需输出长度一般不详(徐等人,2026a); 张等,2025).
第二,虽然DLMs以示威为条件,但他们可能仍然无法可靠地遵循。
了解背景的解码表明,不同背景的对比预测可以加强对示范的遵守(Whitammer等人,2022年;Shi等人,2024年b),但扩大这种指导以完成DLM填充需要共同的可能性,这种可能性往往是棘手的或解码器特有的(Turok等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
In this work, we study how to overcome such challenges.
We state our contributions next.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们研究如何克服这些挑战。
接下来我们阐述我们的贡献。

blocks.en: 1.1 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.1 缴款

blocks.en:
We formulate this task as infilling multiple masked regions of a shared canvas containing demonstrations and surrounding context.
We show that frozen DLMs can generate the missing outputs in place using the visible canvas directly, avoiding the specialized prompting harnesses often needed for causal autoregressive infilling.
blocks.zh:
我们提出这项任务是为了填补一个包含示威和周围环境的共同画布的多个蒙蔽区域。
我们显示,冷冻的DLM可以直接使用可见的画布生成所存在的缺失输出,避免因果自递性填充时往往需要的专用导引带.

blocks.en:
We construct a tractable distribution over complete multi-site infills by revealing one token at a time, allowing us to compare candidate likelihoods with and without demonstrations.
The resulting likelihood-ratio reward enables inference-time importance resampling to favor example-supported completions, offering an additional way to encourage adherence to demonstrations without retraining the generator.
blocks.zh:
我们通过一次透露一个征兆,在完整的多地点填充物上构建一个可拉动的分布,使我们能够比较候选人的可能性和不示威。
由此得到的概率-比率奖励使得推论时间的重要性得以重现,以利于以实例支持的完成,为鼓励坚持示威而不再培训生成者提供了另一种方式。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the effects of demonstrations, target counts, example guidance, and learned length prediction across repurposed few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies.
We find that demonstrations generally improve infilling accuracy and guidance provides additional gains in some settings, but accurate length prediction remains a challenge.
blocks.zh:
我们评价示范、目标计数、示范指导的效果,
我们发现,在有些环境中,示范措施普遍改进了填充的准确性和指导性,提供了额外收益,但准确的长度预测仍然是一个挑战。

blocks.en: 1.2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Few-shot prompting specifies tasks through demonstrations ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , but mappings and placement can affect model behavior ( Min et al., 2022 ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Applications include information extraction and semantic parsing ( Pang et al., 2023 ; Shin and Van Durme, 2022 ) , as well as programming by example and code editing, where demonstrations or prior edits guide subsequent transformations ( Gulwani, 2011 ; Meng et al., 2011 ; Gupta et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) .
Prior work also explores batching multiple inputs into a single prompt, allowing their answers to be generated in one model call ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) .
We instead study joint infilling of multiple unresolved regions in place within a shared canvas containing demonstrations and surrounding context.
blocks.zh:
很少镜头提示通过演示来指定任务(Brown等人,2020年),但绘图和放置会影响模型行为(Min等人,2022年;Wei等人,2023年;Li等人,2026年).
应用包括信息提取和语义解析(Pang等人,2023年;Shin and Van Durme,2022年),以及按例编程和代码编辑,其中示威或之前的编辑指导后续的转换(Gulwani,2011年;Meng等人,2011年;Gupta等人,2023年;Wei等人,2024年).
先前的工作还探索将多个输入分批为单一的快速,使其答案可以在一个模式调用中生成(Cheng等人,2023年;Lin等人,2024年).
相反,我们研究在一个包含示威和周围环境的共享画布内联合填补多个尚未解决的区域。

blocks.en:
Beyond few-shot prompting, various test-time guidance methods have been developed to steer model generation.
Contrastive decoding compares predictions from different models ( Li et al., 2023 ; O’Brien and Lewis, 2023 ) , while context-aware methods compare predictions under different conditioning contexts to strengthen the influence of supplied evidence or demonstrations ( Whitammer et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2024b ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ) .
In diffusion models, classifier-free guidance adjusts the influence of conditioning information ( Ho and Salimans, 2021 ) , while KL-regularized reward tilting ( Korbak et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) and inference-time resampling ( Singhal et al., 2025 ) provide mechanisms for reweighting candidate generations.
However, extending likelihood-based comparisons to complete DLM infills requires tractable sequence-level likelihoods under a specified decoding procedure.
blocks.zh:
除了几发催导外,还开发了各种试验时间指导方法来指导模型生成。
对比解码比较了不同模型的预测(Li等人,2023年;O'Brien和Lewis,2023年),而上下文感方法比较了不同条件背景下的预测,以加强所提供的证据或演示的影响(Whitammer等人,2022年;Shi等人,2023年)。 2024b; Peng等人, 2025; Song等人, 2025).
在扩散模型中,无分级制导调整了调节信息的影响(Ho and Salimans, 2021),而KL规范化的奖励倾斜(Korbak等人, 2022年;Rafailov等人, 2023年)和推论时间重采样(Singhal等人, 2025年)则提供了对候选一代进行重采的机制.
然而,扩大基于可能性的比较以完成DLM填充,需要在特定解码程序下可牵引序列级概率.

blocks.en:
Masked diffusion language models iteratively unmask positions within a shared canvas, supporting flexible generation orders and parallel decoding ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024a ) .
Recent models include LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2025 ) , Dream ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , and dQwen3.5 ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , alongside diffusion-augmented autoregressive approaches such as Uno ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ) .
Standard masked infilling also requires allocating output lengths in advance, motivating work on flexible-length generation and length prediction ( Xu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) .
Prior work shows that decoding strategies affect generation quality and efficiency ( Arriola et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) , while the tractability of complete-sequence likelihoods depends on the decoding procedure ( Turok et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
假面扩散语言模型在共享画布中迭代解析位置,支持灵活生成命令和平行解码(Austin等人,2021年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年a年).
最近的模型包括LLaDA(Nie等人,2025年),Dream (Ye等人,2025年),Nemotron-Labs-Difusion (Fu等人,2026年),和dQuen3.5(Xue等人,2026年),与Uno(Sahoo等人,2026年)等扩散式自动递减方法并列.

先前的研究表明,编码策略影响生成质量和效率(Arriola等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年;Kim等人,2026年),而完全序列可能性的可携带性取决于编码程序(Turok等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Masked Diffusion Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 蒙面扩散语言模型

blocks.en:
Like BERT-style masked language modeling ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , masked DLMs predict missing tokens using visible context on both sides of each masked position ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024a ) .
At each masked position i ∈ M ⁡ ( z ) i\in M(z) , the model predicts a distribution P DLM ​ ( v i ∣ z ) P_{\mathrm{DLM}}(v_{i}\mid z) over candidate tokens v i ∈ V v_{i}\in V .
Turning these predictions into complete infills requires a decoding algorithm that determines which masked positions to reveal and when.
Common strategies select positions by prediction confidence or a prescribed order, potentially revealing multiple tokens in parallel ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Fruytier et al., 2026 ) .
As illustrated in Figure 2 , newly revealed tokens become visible context for subsequent predictions, including those at other target sites.
Different decoding procedures can induce different distributions over complete infills, so we seek a decoder that permits exact sampling and scoring.

blocks.en: 3 Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting and Reward Guidance
blocks.zh: 3 多目标 少点提示和奖励指导

blocks.en:
While Section 2 assumes known output lengths, practical multi-target few-shot prompting must generally determine both the lengths and contents of missing outputs.
We formulate this joint generation problem using a shared canvas with one placeholder per target site.
To characterize the complete infills produced by a DLM, we construct tractable likelihoods under one-token-at-a-time decoding.
These likelihoods additionally enable reward guidance to encourage adherence to the demonstrations.

这些可能性还有助于提供奖励指导,鼓励遵守示威。

blocks.en: 4 Few-Shot Prompting Experiments with Standard Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4次带有标准基准的热点推进实验

blocks.en:
We first quantify the effects of demonstrations and example guidance in single-target infilling ( Section 4.1 ).
We then investigate how these effects change when multiple targets are infilled jointly ( Section 4.2 ).
Finally, we evaluate the impact of predicting target lengths rather than supplying them through an oracle ( Section 4.3 ).
We defer additional experiments to Appendix B , such as on guidance strength ( Section B.5 ) and likelihood sharpening ( Section B.6 ).

然后,我们调查在联合填充多个目标时这些影响是如何变化的(第4.2节)。
最后,我们评价预测目标长度而不是通过甲骨文提供目标长度的影响(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate four benchmarks spanning different few-shot transformations: SST-2 ( Socher et al., 2013 ; Wang et al., 2018 ) with demonstration-defined sentiment codes, List Functions–Easy ( BIG-bench authors, 2023 ; Rule, 2020 ) for list transformations, SALT repetition ( Zheng et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) for artificial-language transformations, and Movie Director ( Liu et al., 2012 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ) for information extraction.
We use three DLMs: LLaDA-1.5 ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-8B ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , and dQwen3.5-9B-Base ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , together with Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as an autoregressive single-target comparison.

blocks.en:
We begin with single-target infilling, which closely resembles conventional autoregressive few-shot prompting, except that DLMs generate a masked output rather than a continuation.
Since few-shot prompting is sensitive to demonstration selection and ordering ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) , we hold the target fixed when comparing different demonstration counts.
We first randomly draw a sequence of 16 16 demonstrations from the benchmark, followed by one target.
For each D ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } D\in\{1,2,4,8,16\} , we construct a prompt by retaining only the first D D demonstrations while keeping the target unchanged.
These five related prompts form a prompt family , allowing us to vary the demonstration count without changing the target or previously included demonstrations.
We evaluate 64 64 families per benchmark across four tasks and four model interfaces, drawing K = 64 K=64 samples for each prompt. Figure 5 reports standard infilling accuracy and the gain from guidance.

blocks.en:
We construct multi-site editing tasks from Extract Method commits in SWE-Refactor ( Xu et al., 2026b ) .
Each task includes the extracted helper, D D accepted <old> / <new> demonstrations, and J J masked replacement sites.
We evaluate 127 tasks from 50 commits across 14 repositories, with ( D , J ) ∈ { 1 , 2 } 2 (D,J)\in\{1,2\}^{2} ; different configurations have different eligible commits ( Section C.1 ).
Frozen LLaDA-1.5 ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) generates K = 16 K=16 rewrites per task using either oracle lengths or lengths sampled from a separately trained Java predictor.
We compare unguided sampling ( β = 0 \beta=0 ) with example guidance ( β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 ) on the same samples.
We assess joint correctness using Claude Sonnet 5.5, without executing the generated code.

blocks.en:
A separate post-hoc ablation on 80 tasks compares generation with and without one visible accepted edit, holding the other prompt components and oracle lengths fixed.
Adding the demonstration improves joint LLM-judged success by 14.7 and 17.5 percentage points for J = 1 J=1 and J = 2 J=2 , respectively ( Section C.2 ).
These gains indicate that the DLM can use a demonstrated refactoring to guide edits at other sites.
Under unguided sampling, pooled joint success reaches 74.4% with oracle lengths but only 15.8% with predicted lengths ( Table 1 ).
This gap identifies length allocation as a major opportunity for improvement, even though the predictor outperforms a simple length prior ( Figure 8 , left).
Example guidance at β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 reduces success to 71.5% and 14.5%, respectively ( Table 1 ).
Thus, demonstrations help the DLM generate appropriate rewrites, but the additional likelihood-ratio reward does not improve their selection in this experiment.

加上示范,LLM-判定的联合成功率分别提高了14.7%和17.5个百分点,J=1J=1和J=2J=2(C.2节)。
这些收益表明,DLM可以使用显示的重构来指导其他网站的编辑.

这种差距将长度分配确定为改进的主要机会,尽管预测器在前面的长度比简单的长(图8,左)。

因此,演示帮助DLM生成适当的重写,但额外的概率-ratio奖励并不能改善他们在实验中的选择.

blocks.en: 5.2 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 定性分析

blocks.en:
The limited benefits of guidance may arise because the sampled rewrites offer little room for improvement, or because the reward fails to identify correct candidates.
With oracle lengths, only 23 of 127 sample pools contain both judged-correct and judged-incorrect rewrites, so even a perfect selector could improve pooled success by at most 8.3 percentage points.
With learned lengths, 72 of 127 pools contain both outcomes, and the corresponding upper bound rises to 45.2 points ( Section C.3 ).
Thus, limited selection opportunities help explain the oracle-length results, whereas learned-length sampling leaves substantial room for better selection.
blocks.zh:
指导的好处有限,可能是因为抽样重写几乎没有改进的余地,或者因为奖励没有找到正确的候选人。
有了甲骨文长度,127个样本池中只有23个包含被判断正确和被判断不正确的重写,所以即使是一个完美的选择者,最多能提高8.3个百分点的集合成功率.
有了学习的长度,127个集合中有72个包含两种结果,相应的上界值上升到45.2分(C.3节.
因此,有限的选择机会有助于解释甲骨文长度的结果,而学长的取样则为更好的选择留下了很大的空间。

blocks.en:
A post-hoc Checkstyle example illustrates how the reward can favor an incorrect rewrite.
An incorrect edit to logMessage changes the logged line number and message type, yet receives a higher example reward than the developer-consistent rewrite (8.69 versus 2.05 nats).
At β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , this gives the incorrect rewrite approximately 28 times the resampling weight of each correct occurrence.
Despite appearing only once among K = 16 K=16 samples, compared with seven occurrences of the correct rewrite, it receives 61.8% of the total weight, reducing expected LLM-judged success from 43.8% to 15.7%.
Here, correct rewrites are available, but the reward disproportionately favors an incorrect one ( Section C.3 ).

这里有正确的改写,但报酬不成比例地偏向错误的(C.3节)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce and study multi-target few-shot prompting with masked DLMs, where demonstrations guide the infilling of multiple regions within a shared canvas.
One-token-at-a-time decoding with deterministic position selection defines a normalized distribution over complete infills, enabling exact sampling, scoring, and likelihood-based example guidance.
Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and Java refactoring, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance providing further gains in several settings.
Our experiments further investigate the benefits of example guidance relative to likelihood sharpening, while identifying opportunities to improve target-length allocation for practical editing.
Together, these findings provide a foundation for more effective example-guided multi-site infilling.

blocks.en:
Our framework assumes that target sites and demonstration-output positions E E are specified in advance, leaving their automatic identification for future work.
The deterministic, one-token-at-a-time decoding used for exact sampling and scoring does not exploit parallel generation, while the induced distribution may depend on the reveal order and model interface for learned DLMs.
Moreover, target lengths must be allocated before infilling, making improved length prediction an important direction for practical use.
Example guidance measures relative support from demonstrations rather than correctness, so its effectiveness depends on how the reward ranks sampled infills.
Increasing guidance strength can also concentrate resampling weights without necessarily improving accuracy ( Section B.5 ).
Our experiments include an autoregressive comparison for single-target prompting, while systematic comparison for multi-target infilling remains future work.
Finally, the Java refactoring study uses an LLM judge rather than code execution, includes commits examined during development, and contains some prompts in which reference text appears elsewhere in the context.

Each node corresponds to a partially revealed canvas, and the decoding policy selects the next target position to reveal.

blocks.en: This appendix documents the experiments of Section 4 and provides additional analyses of demonstration conditioning, example guidance, and length allocation.

blocks.en: B.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: B.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We study four types of few-shot transformations: classification, list transformation, artificial-language transformation, and information extraction.
For SST-2 ( Socher et al., 2013 ; Wang et al., 2018 ) , sentiment labels are replaced by two resampled single-token capital-letter codes; the first two demonstrations cover both classes, and answers are graded by exact code match.
List Functions–Easy ( BIG-bench authors, 2023 ; Rule, 2020 ) uses 85 unconditional functions adapted from BIG-bench List Functions; the transformation rule is hidden, and parsed integer lists are matched exactly.
SALT repetition ( Zheng et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) uses categories 5–6 with a separate dictionary for each example to translate words and repeat each verb or adjective; generated pairs pass an executable-rule check, and outputs are matched exactly.
Movie Director ( Liu et al., 2012 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ) extracts the Director field from audited MIT Movie queries without naming the field in the instruction; labels are fixed, and outputs are graded by exact string match.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了四类几发转换:分类,列表转换,人工语言转换,以及信息提取.
对于SST-2(Socher et al.,2013;Wang et al.,2018),情绪标签被两个重印的单脚大写字母代码所取代;前两个演示涵盖了两个类,答案以精确的代码匹配来分级.
List函数–Easy(BIG-bench 作者,2023;Rule,2020)使用85个从BIG-bench List函数改编的无条件函数;变换规则被隐藏,解析的整数列表精确匹配.
SALT重复(郑等人,2025年a); Zheng et al., 2025b)使用第5-6类,每个例子都有单独的词典来翻译单词,重复每个动词或形容词;生成的对子通过可执行规则检查,输出精确匹配.
电影导演 (Liu et al.,2012; Zhao et al.,2021)从经审计的麻省理工学院电影公司查询中提取主任字段,但没有在指令中给字段命名;标签是固定的,产出是通过精确的字符串匹配来分级的.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: B.2 Single-Target Experiments
blocks.zh: B.2 单一目标实验

blocks.en:
To examine why additional demonstrations improve unguided accuracy in Section 4.1 , we measure how their presence changes the likelihood of the reference answer.
For each prompt family, we retain the same target as D D grows and evaluate the reference completion u ⋆ u^{\star} under both demonstration contexts.
We report its example reward per target token: R ⁡ ( u ⋆ ) | T | = log ⁡ P 1 ​ ( u ⋆ ) − log ⁡ P 0 ​ ( u ⋆ ) | T | . \frac{R(u^{\star})}{|T|}=\frac{\log P_{1}(u^{\star})-\log P_{0}(u^{\star})}{|T|}. This is equivalently the reduction in reference-answer negative log likelihood per token when demonstration outputs become visible.
The reward generally increases with D D , indicating that additional demonstrations provide greater relative support for the reference answer.
Because P 0 P_{0} masks demonstration outputs for DLMs but removes them from causal prompts, reward magnitudes are not directly comparable across these interfaces.
blocks.zh:
为了审查为什么在第4.1节中增加演示会提高无指导的准确性,我们衡量这些演示会如何改变参考答案的可能性。
对于每个迅速的家庭,我们保留着与D D 成长相同的目标,并在两个演示背景下评价参考完成u u ustar}.
我们报告每个目标符号的奖励例子:R ⁡ (u ⋆) | T | = log ⁡ P 1 (u ⋆)- log ⁡ P 0 (u ⋆) | T | .\ frac{R(u^{\star}) }{| {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}哦! {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我...  T. 这相当于在显示产出可见时,每个符号的参考回答负对数概率下降。
奖励一般随着DD的增加而增加,表明额外的示威为参考答案提供了更大的相对支持.
因为P 0 P_{0} 遮蔽 DLM 的演示输出但将其从因果提示中去除,所以悬赏量在这些界面之间并不直接可比.

blocks.en:
Greater support for a reference answer does not, however, guarantee a larger gain from guidance.
At D = 1 D=1 , SST-2 exposes only one class code, while a single List Functions or SALT demonstration may be compatible with several rules.
At larger D D , unguided accuracy can approach saturation, leaving less room for additional improvement.
Moreover, guidance depends on how the reward ranks the sampled alternatives, not only on its value for the reference answer.
blocks.zh:
然而,更多地支持参考答复并不能保证从指导中获得更大的收益。
在D=1 D=1时,SST-2只曝光一个类代码,而一个单列表函数或SALT演示可能与几个规则兼容.
在较大的D D 中,无导精度可以接近饱和度,为额外改进留下的空间较少.
此外,指导取决于奖励如何对抽样替代品进行排序,而不仅仅取决于奖励对参考答案的价值。

blocks.en: B.3 Multi-Target Experiments
blocks.zh: B.3 多目标实验

blocks.en:
Section 4.2 shows that the effects of example guidance vary with the number of jointly infilled targets.
We investigate this behavior with two additional analyses: a reference-likelihood diagnostic that follows successive targets, and a separate cross-benchmark target-count study.
The latter uses D = 4 D=4 and K = 64 K=64 samples per canvas, rather than the K = 16 K=16 pools of the main List Functions–Easy D × J D\times J grid.
blocks.zh:
第4.2节表明,实例指导的效果随共同填充目标的数量而不同。
我们用另外两项分析来调查这种行为:一个是跟随连续目标进行的参照相似性诊断,另一个是单独的跨基准目标计数研究.
后者使用D=4 D=4,K=64 K=64个样板,而非K=16 K=16个主列表函数集合–Easy D×J D\times J网格.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: C.1 Benchmark Construction and Evaluation Setup

blocks.en:
We derive multi-site editing tasks from Extract Method commits in SWE-Refactor ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , which provide before-and-after snapshots and extracted helpers.
For each (repository, commit, file, helper) group, we identify updated callers and represent each minimal changed region as a <old> / <new> pair.
A seeded file-order rule assigns D D accepted edits as demonstrations and J J remaining sites as targets.
Eligibility rules fixed before inspecting outcomes exclude edits requiring identifiers or literals absent from the prompt or changing asserted values.
We also limit replacements to 80 LLaDA tokens and enclosing methods to 200 lines, retain one helper per commit and file, and collapse mirrored commits.
The resulting benchmark contains 127 tasks from 50 commits across 14 repositories, with ( D , J ) ∈ { 1 , 2 } 2 (D,J)\in\{1,2\}^{2} and at most one task per group and configuration.
Because eligible commits differ across configurations, comparisons across ( D , J ) (D,J) in Table 1 do not isolate the effect of demonstration or target count; results are aggregated and bootstrapped by commit.

blocks.en:
Frozen LLaDA-1.5 ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) generates K = 16 K=16 rewrites per task under each length setting; unguided sampling and example guidance use the same stored samples.
We use Claude Sonnet 5.5 ( claude-sonnet-5-5 ) as a Claude Code sub-agent, with a fixed judging rubric and fresh context per call.
Each judging packet contains the helper and its Javadoc, accepted demonstrations, and target methods with candidate rewrites inserted, but excludes developer references, generation settings, length allocations, and model scores.
The judge assesses whether the edits adapt receivers, arguments, and control flow while plausibly preserving behavior; equivalent rewrites may pass, while incomplete or erroneous edits fail.
Joint success requires every target to be judged correct; uncertain judgments count as failures, and ill-posed packets remain in the evaluation.
Duplicate candidate texts are judged once per task, but duplicate draws remain in the sample pools; we report unadjusted 95% paired commit-bootstrap intervals.
We do not compile or execute the generated code.

我们使用Claude Sonnet 5.5(claude-sonnet-5-5)作为Claude代码的子代理,每个呼叫都有固定的判断符号和新的上下文.
每个判断包包含帮助器及其Javadoc,接受演示,以及插入候选重写的目标方法,但不包括开发者引用,生成设置,长度分配和模型分数.
法官在合理保留行为的同时,评估编辑是否调整了接收器,参数,和控制流;等效重写可能通过,而不完整或错误的编辑失败.

The 4,064 generated draws yielded 2,089 distinct judging packets after deduplication within tasks, including across length settings.
The judge classified all 46 blinded validation cases as expected, and ten repeated judgments agreed, although these checks do not replace execution-based evaluation.
Its inherited agent context contained brief summaries of earlier Section 5 results, but no packet-specific labels; judge sampling parameters were not explicitly set or recorded.
All 50 source commits were examined during development, and some prompts contain target-reference text elsewhere in the helper or demonstrations, so this study is not a held-out evaluation.

blocks.en: C.2 Demonstration Conditioning and Length Allocation
blocks.zh: C.2 示范条件和长度分配

blocks.en:
To measure the effect of demonstration conditioning, we compare D = 0 D=0 and D = 1 D=1 on the same 80 editing tasks (52 with J = 1 J=1 , 28 with J = 2 J=2 ) in a post-hoc ablation.
Both conditions share the helper, target sites, oracle lengths, chat framing, K = 16 K=16 , and unguided sampling ( β = 0 \beta=0 ).
They use the instruction: “Complete each target <new> span by applying the intended refactoring using the helper shown in the source context; use any accepted before/after edits if provided.”
Only demonstration visibility changes during generation; the judge sees the accepted edit in both conditions.

为了衡量演示调制的效果,我们比较D=0 D=0和D=1 D=1 相同80个编辑任务(52个与J=1 J=1,28个与J=2 J=2)在一次后热衰变中.
这两个条件都共享帮助器,目标站点,甲骨文长度,聊天框架,K = 16 K = 16,以及无制导采样(β = 0\β=0).
它们使用指令:“通过在源上下文中显示的帮助,应用预定的重构,完成每个目标<新>的间距;如果提供,在编辑之前/之后使用任何已接受的。 “
只有演示可见度在生成期间有所变化;裁判员在两种条件下都看到被接受的编辑.

blocks.en:
Adding one demonstration improves joint LLM-judged success by 14.7 percentage points for J = 1 J=1 ( [ + 5.8 , + 24.5 ] [+5.8,+24.5] ) and 17.5 points for J = 2 J=2 ( [ + 4.7 , + 32.5 ] [+4.7,+32.5] ).
The estimated gain is smaller on commits outside the narrower LLaDA development subset ( + 5.3 +5.3 points, [ − 1.0 , + 13.9 ] [-1.0,+13.9] ).
The ablation was designed after inspecting the main results but fixed before collecting its own outcomes; its instruction differs from the main experiment, so absolute success rates are not directly comparable.

在较窄的LLaDA开发子集(+ 5.3+5.3点,+5.3点)之外承付的估计收益较小, [−1.0,+13.9] [-1.0,+13.9].
衰减是在检查了主要结果后设计的,但在收集自己的结果之前就固定了;它的指令与主要实验不同,因此绝对成功率并不直接可比.

blocks.en:
We train a Java-specific length predictor using the LLaDA-1.5 architecture and objective of Section B.4 , with edits from 21 training and four development repositories in the 28-repository corpus; the remaining three repositories and all SWE-Refactor repositories are excluded.
Training prompts contain an optional helper declaration, D D accepted <old> / <new> demonstrations, and J J targets with visible <old> spans and one placeholder per missing <new> span.
We use seeded, disjoint site assignments, retain up to 20 context lines before and 12 after each edit, and exclude empty replacements, lengths above 256 tokens, and prompts exceeding 2,048 tokens.
Reference lengths are withheld from the inputs, with prompt-invariance checks to detect leakage.
This yields helper-only and all-multi-site corpora with 1,887/370 and 13,543/3,598 training/development prompts, respectively, where the latter includes the former.
Training alternates between the corpora equally for 313 updates (batch size 64, 16 warm-up updates, cosine decay), with other settings following Section B.4 .
We also train an alternative on the all-multi-site corpus alone and select by exact-length probability mass F 0 F_{0} on 488 helper-only development targets (0.0664 versus 0.0660), although within-two-token mass F 2 F_{2} would favor the alternative (0.317 versus 0.328); SWE-Refactor outcomes are not used for selection.

我们使用LLaDA-1.5架构和B.4节的目标培训一个爪哇语专用的长度预测器,编辑了21个培训和28个存储器中的4个开发存储器;其余3个存储器和所有SWE-Refactor寄存器被排除在外。
培训提示包含一个可选的帮助者声明,DD接受 " old " / " new " 演示,JJ目标带有可见的 " old " 跨度,每个缺失的 " new " 跨度有一个占位符。

输入物中不包含参考长度,并进行即时变化检查以检测渗漏。
这只产生帮助器和全多场公司,分别为1,887/370和13,543/3,598个培训/发展提示,后者包括前者。
Corpora之间培训的候补人员平均为313个更新(批量尺寸64,16个热身更新,余弦衰减),其他设置则遵循B.4节.
我们还在全多地点体上单独培训一种替代品,并按精确概率F 0 F_{0}在488个只帮助人的发展目标(0.0664对0.0660)上进行选择,尽管在两脚内的质量F 2 F_{2}将倾向于这一替代品(0.317对0.328);SWE-Refactor results results不用于选择。

blocks.en:
At evaluation, the selected predictor runs once per task and independently samples target lengths for each of K = 16 K=16 rewrites, without temperature adjustment or truncation.
Oracle lengths equal the developer-reference token counts; 3.3% of predicted per-target lengths exceed the benchmark’s 80-token reference-length eligibility limit.
We compare length fidelity against the empirical distribution of 2,467 replacement lengths in the helper-only training corpus, distinct from the demonstration-length prior in Section 4.3 .
Across 80 unique target sites, the predictor assigns 26.7% probability mass within two tokens of the reference length ( [ 20.1 , 33.8 ] [20.1,33.8] ), compared with 15.2% for this prior; exact-length mass is 6.8% versus 3.1%.
However, only 6.2% of learned-length joint samples allocate every target exactly.
Among learned-length samples, 95% with exact joint allocations are judged correct, compared with 13% for near-but-incorrect allocations and 8% otherwise.
These descriptive associations help explain the large oracle-versus-learned accuracy gap in Table 1 , while highlighting the importance of accurate joint length allocation.

Oracle 长度等于开发者参考符号计数;预测的每个目标长度的3.3%超过基准的80个参考长度合格限度.
我们比较了长度忠贞度与经验分布2 467个替代长度,这与第4.3节之前的演示长度不同。
在80个独特的目标地点中,预测器在参考长度的两个符号内分配了26.7%的概率质量([20.1、33.8] [20.1、33.8]),而以前这一数值为15.2%;准确长度质量为6.8%,而以前为6.8%。 3.1% (韩语).
然而,只有6.2%的学长联合样本准确分配每个目标。
在学长的样本中,95%的精确联合分配被判定正确,而13%的近但不正确分配则被判定正确,8%的则被判定正确。
这些描述性联系有助于解释表1中甲骨文与获取的准确性差距,同时强调准确的合用长度分配的重要性。

Selection helps only when a sample pool contains both correct and incorrect rewrites.
Among 127 oracle-length pools, 87 contain only judged-correct samples, 17 only incorrect samples, and 23 both; the corresponding counts with learned lengths are 0, 55, and 72.
Selecting a correct rewrite whenever one is available could therefore improve pooled success by at most 8.3 points with oracle lengths, versus 45.2 points with learned lengths.
Even within the 23 mixed oracle-length pools, guidance lowers expected success from 62.0% to 50.5% ( − 11.5 -11.5 points, [ − 19.7 , − 3.1 ] [-19.7,-3.1] ); this is a post-hoc comparison on an outcome-selected subset.

blocks.en:
Multi-target few-shot prompting could enable example-guided document and code editing across multiple sites.
Practical use will require more reliable adherence to demonstrations and better prediction of output lengths.
With these improvements, users could specify transformations through a few examples rather than editing each site manually.
blocks.zh:
多目标几发提示可以使示范文档和代码编辑跨多个网站。
实际使用需要更可靠地遵守示范,并更好地预测产出长度。
通过这些改进,用户可以通过几个例子来指定转换,而不是手动编辑每个网站.

blocks.en:
Incorrect transformations can propagate across sites, altering document meaning or introducing software defects.
Our Checkstyle case study shows that example guidance can favor an incorrect edit even when demonstrations support the intended transformation.
Practical use requires review, including compilation and testing for code; our evaluation instead relies on an LLM judge without execution.
blocks.zh:
不正确的转换可以跨站点传播,改变文档含义或引入软件缺陷.
我们的 Checkstyle 案例研究 显示, 即使演示支持预期的转换, 示例指导也会倾向于错误的编辑 。
实际使用需要审查,包括汇编和测试代码;我们的评价则依赖不执行的LLM法官。
